scripts.db:types: npx --yes supabase@2 gen types typescript --linked --schema public > src/types/database.ts
scripts.functions:deploy: npx --yes supabase@2 functions deploy get-task-summary send-task-reminders --use-api
scripts.functions:check: (cd supabase/functions/get-task-summary && npx --yes deno check index.ts) && (cd supabase/functions/send-task-reminders && npx --yes deno check index.ts reminders_test.ts)
scripts.functions:test: cd supabase/functions/send-task-reminders && npx --yes deno test --allow-net=jsr.io reminders_test.ts
